acceptance.schoolAuthorityAdmin: Production invitations, billing and administration retain their existing authorization, mandatory MFA, subscription and school-authority boundaries. No administrator account or subscription is changed as QA.
acceptance.schoolScopedAdmin: Existing school and role restrictions remain. No preview receives a credential that can elevate these permissions.
acceptance.transportationAdmin: Existing transportation permissions and billing denials remain. Production functions retain their original credential bytes.
acceptance.guardian: Production access remains limited to linked students. Personal consent, optional MFA, quiet hours and device permissions remain. Previews use synthetic responses and receive no production server credentials.
acceptance.driver: Production access remains limited to own or assigned operations. Personal consent, optional MFA and location permission remain. No trip, location fix or external notification is generated as QA.
acceptance.platformAdmin: Existing privileged authorization and MFA remain. Only the protected, exact-main workflow can apply this policy; encrypted recovery is uploaded before mutation. Previously secret-bearing, unpublished previews are retired without deleting production deployments.
acceptance.channels: No notifications, invoices, charges, invitations or real recipient subscriptions are created as QA.
acceptance.failure: Refuse unknown or inherited credentials, unmanaged dev servers, unreadable all-context values, target drift or inventory overflow. Existing masked production records are retained by ID without sending a masked string as a value. After encrypted recovery is uploaded, first prove the provider's value-reference update behavior with one temporary, non-sensitive, production-functions configuration probe and remove it; do not redeploy or invoke the app for that probe. If it fails, leave real credentials untouched. On partial failure retain recovery and sanitized progress; never restore production secrets to previews. Never delete production deployment records. Recovery captures readable values and provider-owned opaque record references, not a complete external secret vault. Configuration verification and live acceptance remain separate.
